entries.status: No EU-level schedule or class. EU legislation does not establish classes of narcotic or psychotropic substances; Member States classify drugs according to the 1961, 1971 and 1988 UN Conventions. The Framework Decision on illicit drug trafficking defines 'drug' as any substance covered by the 1961 Single Convention (as amended by the 1972 Protocol) or by the 1971 Convention, or listed in its Annex.

entries.note: Entries in the Perechen are unnumbered; no item number is printed. List II = narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances whose circulation is restricted («оборот которых в Российской Федерации ограничен»), with control measures. List I also has «Экгонин и его производные» (ecgonine and its derivatives); cocaine itself is a separate position in List II. The general provisions after List II extend control to isomers, stereoisomers and salts of the substances listed there.
